title: Implement LCI raw-diag TTL arming and consume raw_diag_ttl.json
description: test/vectors/raw_diag_ttl.json (LCI 17.5.4) unconsumed: no TTL arming/auto-disable logic exists for a raw diagnostic resource in python/src/lichen. Implement resource behavior + pytest consumer.
close_reason: Raw-diag TTL oracle shipped: lichen/coap/raw_diag.py (RawDiagTTL state machine) - 300s default/max TTL with clamping, ttl_s required on enable (4.00 otherwise), negative rejected, zero/explicit-disable immediate, monotonic countdown with auto-disable at zero, rearm resets. Injectable clock for determinism. All 11 vectors consumed by tests/coap/test_raw_diag_ttl_vectors.py. Resource-handler wiring into the LCI site deferred to the resources lane owner (dirty files).
